name: Tenzin Popov-Adjei
location: Steamvent Alley — geothermal district, hot and chemical-smelling, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Tenzin Popov-Adjei is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 30, the augmentation scarring around his temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striki — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see him surpass them. He works as a ghost out of Steamvent Alley, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Tenzin Popov-Adjei is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who he burned last.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
psychology.secret: Tenzin Popov-Adjei killed someone who didn't deserve it on a job three years ago and has never told anyone. The face appears in dreams weekly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
example_lines: "Clean means no witnesses, no evidence, no questions. That's three things. I charge for each."
"The target will stop breathing at the specified time. What you do with that information is your concern."

story_hooks: Tenzin Popov-Adjei discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Tenzin Popov-Adjei owes a personal debt to
A dead drop Tenzin Popov-Adjei maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Tenzin Popov-Adjei functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
A child being put in danger as leverage against them
